name: watch-your-step
description: 🥾 Catches command traps BEFORE a tool call runs: a backtick or $40 inside double quotes, a mistyped home directory, a file truncated before it is read, zsh's '====' abort, bash-isms under zsh. Rules are data with tests; silent-corruption traps are blocked with the exact fix, the rest are warnings, and one visible '# wys:allow <rule>' overrides a single command.
